title: Canonical singleton and scalar comparison constructions
statement: For an essentially small site C in coefficient universe w, an inverse ring-sheaf sequence B, a second sequence D, a natural ring map a : B → D, normalized scalar assignment S and tensor coherence T [def-pur-system-level-left-extension-basic], construct the ordinary singleton on the ringed sequence site [lem-pur-system-ringed-sequence-site], its derived functor and transported adjunction [lem-pur-system-single-derived-extension], and the scalar comparisons for a normalized sequence scalar model A [lem-pur-system-scalar-model]. Ordinary and derived scalar comparisons are the left-adjoint uniqueness isomorphisms for the identity-on-sections evaluation/restriction square. The cochain source and target comparisons compose the respective universal comparison maps; lower-singleton maps are transposes of the specified derived below-level evaluation isomorphism [lem-pur-system-single-derived-evaluation]; the scalar square is composed from normalized scalar associators [lem-pur-system-scalar-coherence]. These are exactly the existing fixed constructions, with their unchanged types and bodies, extracted from the parent module.
